items.title: UI localization
items.smarttube: 46 translated strings.xml catalogs plus default English (47 UI languages; languages.xml lists 47 selectable languages, countries.xml 92 countries).
ps5_evidence: native/tube_i18n.c, native/tube_i18n.h: lookup by the English source, patterns, counted patterns with each language's plural rules, label-and-value rows; native/tube_i18n_data.h generated from native/i18n/<tag>.json (21 catalogs: cs da de el es fi fr hu id it nb nl pl pt-BR pt-PT ro ru sv tr uk vi)

scripts/i18n_extract.py (the template of every translatable text), scripts/i18n_build.py (checks and tables), scripts/i18n_overlay.py (browser rows, status line, toasts and the static texts of native/youtube.rml)
The language follows the PS5 system language or the 'Interface language' preference (settings:interface-language)

tests/test_i18n.c, tests/test_i18n_provider.c (scripts/test_i18n.sh: template and tables current, 99% coverage per catalog), tests/test_i18n_ui.cpp (scripts/test_i18n_ui.sh: all 21 languages drawn with the app's fonts); docs/LOCALIZATION.md
gaps: The player interface (controls, in-player menus and lists, pickers, dialogs, on-screen keyboard) stays English: its fonts are baked atlases without accented letters
No Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Thai, Hindi, Telugu, Arabic, Persian or Hebrew: the packaged fonts lack the glyphs, and the pinned RmlUi has no shaping and no right-to-left layout
21 of SmartTube's 46 translations; the other Latin and Cyrillic languages only need a catalog (list in docs/LOCALIZATION.md)
EVO's own texts (its player settings screen, toasts and dialogs), the credits, the changelog and messages worded by the service are not translated
items.notes: The catalogs are new translations keyed by the English source, not conversions of SmartTube's strings.xml. Offline evidence only: the system language query and the GPU text path have not run on a console.

items.title: How ProsperoTube exposes settings
items.smarttube: Settings section with per-topic dialogs (AppDialogPresenter radio/checked/button categories).
ps5_evidence: native/tube_provider.c: list_catalog() branch `else if (!strncmp(parent, "settings", 8))` — first half (`if (!page) {...}`) applies the action encoded in the catalog id, second half emits rows with CATALOG_FOLDER(id,title,detail); final `else` is the top-level list
native/tube_provider.c: root row CATALOG_FOLDER("settings","YouTube preferences",...) and `app:settings` -> EVO SettingsScreen (scripts/prepare_native.py)
native/tube_profile_settings.h: ProfileSettings struct, profile_settings_defaults/capture/apply/read/write
native/tube_provider.c: save() (legacy top-level keys + profile_settings_write) and init() (legacy read, defaults reset)
scripts/prepare_native.py: evo_rmlui_provider.cpp patch — ids starting `settings:` reload in place instead of pushing a folder (except settings:languages / settings:audio-languages)
tests/test_profile_settings.c + scripts/test_native.sh case `profile_settings`
gaps: One list of about 50 rows under YouTube preferences, a dozen of them screens of their own (Interface, Search options, Menu sections, Player controls, Hide content, Backup and restore, About and others); not the categories of SmartTube's dialogs
Two parallel per-profile stores (ProfileSettings and g_player_preferences) plus device-wide EVO cfg
No description of options beyond 'Selected' in the detail text; no radio/check widgets
